title: Actions upon receipt of System Information

entities.name: System Information Reception Procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by the UE upon receiving System Information from the network.

entities.name: System Information
entities.description: Broadcast message containing essential network parameters and configuration.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: UE state where it monitors system information and performs cell selection/reselection.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: UE state where it maintains connection context but operates with reduced signaling.

entities.name: System Information Valid
entities.description: Condition where received System Information is complete and meets validity criteria.

entities.name: Configuration Update
entities.description: UE updates its configuration based on received System Information parameters.

relations.description: Procedure involves receiving System Information message
Procedure is performed when UE is in RRC_IDLE state
Procedure is performed when UE is in RRC_INACTIVE state
Valid System Information triggers configuration update in UE
Procedure includes validation of received System Information
